name: ccash MSB Sandbox Scenario Profile
summary: A test-only MSB profile that exercises ccash account opening, KYC, sanctions screening, deposit, OTC, settlement, and audit controls without touching production customers, production funds, mainnet wallets, or live regulatory filings.

source_repositories.purpose: Go/HTMX operator console, Solana signatures, incoming payment protocol, finreact sidecar integration
Template grain, MSB workflow pack, Station/Process grains, Playwright video QA harness
Legal source registry, BSA/AML obligations, type-safe marker references
Deployment, Solana license controls, release allowlisting, backup and unseal procedures

runtime_modes.description: The profile is loaded as a ccash domain dataset by the AITX Template grain.
AITX qa scenarios drive real Sandstorm UI clicks and produce screenshots, SRT, and MP4 proof artifacts.
ccash Go tests and cmd/roundtrip-smoke verify signed webhook and canonical payload drift without a live chain.

client.purpose_of_account: Business payments, crypto liquidity testing, and compliance workflow validation
client.source_of_funds: Retained earnings and documented business revenue

legal_controls.profile_requirement: The sandbox client must carry FinCEN registration fields as simulated evidence, but must not submit a live BSA E-Filing action.
Each positive and negative path must leave evidence for CDD, source of funds, screening, transaction monitoring, and escalation.
TeleScreen or an explicit sanctions simulator must produce a clear, held, or rejected decision with retained evidence.
Any virtual asset or funds transfer at or above 3000 USD equivalent must collect originator, beneficiary, account/reference, and institution data.
Every scenario must retain screenshots, workflow state, audit rows, and generated proof artifacts.
Because the partner directory is empty for production, interstate partner routing is represented only by mock provider fixtures.

must_pass: ccash domain loads the profile as a JSON dataset
scenario IDs are unique
required personas are present
network is devnet
profile contains no private keys or mock-verification environment flags
client submits account application with KYC fields
document and face capture evidence is attached or explicitly simulated
TeleScreen returns clear decision
compliance approval and executive approval are by different personas
case reaches approved or account_opened terminal state
screening simulator can produce held or rejected
client operational access is blocked
compliance notes are required before closure
audit trail contains screening reference and decision reason
deposit request includes direction, asset type, amount, USD equivalent, origin of funds, and purpose
source of funds verification is required
ledger update occurs through the workflow hook, not direct balance mutation
transaction register contains the reference number
M1 create invoice is idempotent by ccash_txn_id
M2 payment_detected webhook verifies protocol v2 signature
M3 screening dispatch creates or reuses a screening case
M4 decision branches to cleared, held, or rejected
M5 temp credit and M6 move-to-nostro require signed audit evidence
M7 settlement_complete transitions ccash transaction to settled
OTC request includes asset, direction, quantity, notional value, capacity, and source of funds
pricing approval is recorded
executive approval is recorded when risk tier requires it
settlement occurs through account_operation hook
audit phase verifies expected USD and BTC balances
BLOCKCHAIN_NETWORK is devnet for this profile
release hash verification is checked before running browser scenarios
license domain matches dev.pbay.app or the configured Sandstorm dev URL
mainnet-beta is rejected unless a separate production-readiness profile is used
mock Solana verification flags are absent from live-style runs

regression_gates.assertion: Tests must not call direct credit or debit endpoints to fake settlement.
Any four-eyes step must use unique_reviewers and two distinct Sandstorm identities.
Webhook and Solana-signed requests must reject protocol v1 envelopes.
Workflow and scenario data must come from Template grain domain packs or this dataset, not copied into test code.
Sandbox scenarios must not hit mainnet-beta, live BSA E-Filing, production partner MSBs, or production financial rails.

blocked_production_items.reason: The legal Partner MSB directory is not populated. This blocks production interstate routing, but not mock sandbox tests.
FinCEN and state filings are represented as draft evidence only.
This profile is devnet-only and does not assert mainnet release-authority separation.
